Name: Golden Crops
Author: Wandox99
Description:
Hello everyone!
This mod add Golden Crops: a golden version of the vanilla's crops worth 5/10 or 20x more than the vanilla ones.
The golden crops are:
Amaranth
Ancient Fruit
Artichoke
Beet
Blue Jazz
Blueberry
Bok Choy
Cauliflower
Coffee Bean
Corn
Cranberries
Eggplant
Fairy Rose
Garlic
Grape
Green Bean
Hops
Hot Pepper
Kale
Melon
Parsnip
Pineapple
Poppy
Potato
Pumpkin
Radish
Red Cabbage
Rhubarb
Starfruit
Strawberry
Summer Spangle
Sunflower
Sweet Gem Berry
Taro Root
Tomato
Tulip
Wheat
Yam

Every golden crops has the same growing time as the vanilla version.
The price of the seeds and the crops depends on the version of the mod taken, example:
With the 5x version, the price of potato seeds wich in vanilla are worth 50 gold, the golden version will cost 250 gold, and so the value of potato itself
There are a few difference between golden and normal crops:
Golden Crops are not edible;
The Golden Sweet Gem Berry is categorized as a "Fruit" so you can easily make wine from it;
No Golden Seeds are selled from the JojaMart;
The golden flowers do not have color variations;
Pineapple Seeds and Taro Tuber are selled from the Ginger Island trader only in Summer;
The traveling merchants sell every time 10 of each Golden Rare Seeds, Golden Ancient Seeds and Coffee Bean;
You cannot use the Golden Crops for cooking recipe.
Every Golden Crops has changed some gifting taste for the NPC:
If they loved or liked the normal version: they will love the golden version;
If they hated or disliked the normal version: they will hate the golden version;
If the normal version was a neutral gift, it keep being a neutral gift;
Golden Coffee has +2 speed and a time buff that depends of the mod version (if 5/10 or 20x);
The Golden Oil is not edible;
Golden Beer and Golden Pale Ale give 1 luck, -1 defense and speed for 1:30m;
Sunflower do not drop sunflower seeds and because of this, the price of the Golden Sunflower has been changed (as if in the vanilla the seeds cost 100 gold and the sunflower 160 gold, multiplied by the 5/10 or 20x version);
This mod is already compatible with the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11323]Domed Garden Pots[/url] mod, in a optional file found on the mod's page.

[size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

Use only one version for this mod, you don't need to download the 5x version if you want to play with the 10x, the same for the others.


[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels
